title: All the World's a Stage
description: Drama is both the generalized form and essence of reality. Just what kind of light does the story onstage reflect in his eyes?

questNarration.text: You dare to defy your orders and abandon the front?

#Having {NICKNAME} here will help to keep things interesting, though. And being close to where the action's happening is always exciting.
So must it be... Hahaha, yes, so must it be!
I always like to extricate myself before things start getting tedious.
